title: Korean Football Team Names: an English-to-Korean mapping for European club football
description:
An open mapping of English club names returned by the football-data.org API to the Korean names used by Korean broadcasters and sports media.

Covers 264 clubs across the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and their respective second divisions, plus clubs encountered in the UEFA Champions League. Second-division clubs are included because promoted sides otherwise break any first-division-only mapping every August. Common API name variants (for example Inter and FC Internazionale Milano) are stored as separate keys so lookups succeed without normalisation.

Distributed as JSON and CSV. Maintained by Walking Football, a Korean-language site covering European club football.
